### The Persecution to Come
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/persecution-to-come
Passage: John 16:1-4
Points:
- Jesus forewarned His disciples about impending hatred and persecution to protect them from stumbling or falling into apostasy.
- Christ foretold that much of this opposition would be religiously motivated, with persecutors mistakenly believing that killing believers serves God.
- Knowing what was to come reinforced the disciples' confidence in Jesus' prophetic foresight and sovereign control over future trials.
- Being forewarned spiritually prepares believers so that the hardship of persecution does not take them by surprise.
- Believers must remain alert to worldly hostility and guard their hearts against loving the world so they can stand firm.
